items.source_en:
The goal of Project UCE-86 (ComSpike) is to create a highly sensitive receiver, capable of picking up communication signals and decrypting them on the spot. Signal range would be star system-wide at a minimum of 50 AU.

The receiver would be strong enough to pick up traces of frequencies potentially weakened by distance, atmosphere, or a gravitational field. 

Decryption software would be smart enough to both decrypt any signal within nanoseconds and propose any missing or corrupted data.

Benefits:
   -- Distress signals become easy to locate and interpret. 
   -- Imperial security could detect hostile frequencies before they become a threat.

The receiver would be strong enough to pick up traces of frequencies potentially weakened by distance, atmosphere, or a gravitational field. 

Decryption software would be smart enough to both decrypt any signal within nanoseconds and propose any missing or corrupted data.

Benefits:
   -- Distress signals become easy to locate and interpret. 
   -- UC security could detect hostile frequencies before they become a threat.
   -- Hostile embedded messaging could be easily exposed.
   -- Communications across the system are greatly increased with fewer delays.

items.source_en:
It amuses me how nervous I make Ms. Lovelace. But she intrigues me. The droids taught me little of the new science.  So I piece it together with talks with her.

Last night Ada told me of her theories about cloning. About this DNA. Now I wonder if I'm even a clone of Genghis? 

I know from my education that the real Genghis is a mysterious figure. No one knows where he was buried, where he was born, or almost anything.

So how did they capture his DNA? Or did they? One way or the other, I may share his name - but I am my own man.
items.legacy_ko:
러브레이스 양을 긴장하게 만드는 것이 재미있다. 하지만 그녀는 흥미로운 사람이다. 드로이드들은 새로운 과학에 대해 거의 가르쳐주지 않았다. 그래서 그녀와의 대화를 통해 조각들을 맞춰가고 있다.

어젯밤 에이다는 복제에 대한 자신의 이론을 이야기해주었다. 이 DNA에 대해서 말이다. 이제 내가 정말 칭기즈칸의 복제 인간인지조차 의문이 든다.

교육을 통해 알기로 실제 칭기즈칸은 미스터리한 인물이다. 그가 어디에 묻혔는지, 어디서 태어났는지, 그 외 거의 아무것도 알려진 게 없다.

그렇다면 그들은 어떻게 그의 DNA를 확보했을까? 아니면 확보하긴 한 걸까? 어쨌든 나는 그의 이름을 공유하고 있을지 모르지만, 나는 나만의 길을 가는 사람이다.
